# Blueprint Analysis: CommonMark

## Commander Expectations

- assert the executable reads Markdown from standard input and writes HTML to standard output.
- assert the parser conforms to the supplied CommonMark 0.31.2 specification.
- assert the supplied scoring assets remain unchanged.

## Crew

| Crew | Charge |
|---|---|
| Commander | Defines intent and decides what done means. |
| Team Lead | Confirms epic completeness and stakeholder expectations. |
| Planning Crew | Authors atomic specifications and the ordered Manifest. |
| Shipyard Crew | Builds the tickets without synchronous Commander access. |

## Story List

### Feature: Command-Line Parser

| ID | Story | High-level AC |
|---|---|---|
| CLI-001 | Deliver the `commonmark` executable | The executable reads UTF-8 Markdown from stdin and writes HTML to stdout. |

### Feature: Block Parsing

| ID | Story | High-level AC |
|---|---|---|
| BLOCKS-001 | Parse paragraphs and thematic breaks | Paragraphs and thematic breaks follow the supplied rules. |
| BLOCKS-002 | Parse ATX and setext headings | Heading levels, content, and boundaries follow the supplied rules. |
| BLOCKS-003 | Parse indented and fenced code blocks | Code block content and fence rules follow the supplied rules. |
| BLOCKS-004 | Parse HTML blocks | The seven HTML block types follow their start and end conditions. |
| BLOCKS-005 | Parse link reference definitions | Definitions are collected and resolved according to the supplied rules. |
| BLOCKS-006 | Parse block quotes | Block quote structure and lazy continuation follow the supplied rules. |
| BLOCKS-007 | Parse lists and list items | Markers, nesting, continuation, empty items, and tightness follow the supplied rules. |

### Feature: Inline Parsing

| ID | Story | High-level AC |
|---|---|---|
| INLINE-001 | Parse escapes and character references | Backslash escapes and valid entity and numeric references render correctly. |
| INLINE-002 | Parse code spans | Matching backtick runs and code span whitespace normalization follow the supplied rules. |
| INLINE-003 | Parse emphasis and strong emphasis | Delimiter runs and precedence follow the supplied algorithm. |
| INLINE-004 | Parse links, reference links, and images | Inline and reference forms, labels, destinations, titles, and alt text follow the supplied rules. |
| INLINE-005 | Parse autolinks and raw HTML | URI/email autolinks and inline HTML are recognized and rendered correctly. |
| INLINE-006 | Parse hard and soft line breaks | Line endings, trailing spaces, and backslash breaks follow the supplied rules. |
| INLINE-007 | Render remaining textual content | Uninterpreted text and internal spaces are preserved with correct HTML escaping. |

### Feature: Full Conformance Verification

| ID | Story | High-level AC |
|---|---|---|
| VERIFY-001 | Pass the complete supplied conformance suite | The unfiltered supplied suite completes with exit code zero. |

## Surfaced Acceptance Criteria

None.

| `sources/spec.txt` | test-kit-to-implementation | `sources/spec_tests.py` | Contains the normative rules and embedded examples parsed by the conformance runner. | Organize implementation stories around the spec sections and use section selectors for focused checks. |
| `sources/spec_tests.py` | test-kit-to-implementation | `sources/cmark.py`, `sources/normalize.py`, `sources/spec.txt` | Imports `cmark` and `normalize`; reads the spec file. | Stage all three dependencies with the runner. |
| `sources/full_test.sh` | test-kit-to-implementation | `commonmark` | Checks and invokes `./commonmark` using the complete unfiltered suite. | The executable must exist at the application root before final verification. |
| `sources/cmark.py` | implementation-to-helper | `commonmark` | Runs the supplied program when `--program` is specified. | Use the executable as the implementation under test; do not treat the reference library path as the deliverable. |

## Planning Instructions

### Delivery Shape

Build a command-line Markdown-to-HTML parser. Its input is UTF-8 Markdown on standard input; its output is HTML on standard output. The implementation resolves block structure before parsing inline content, using document-wide link reference definitions during inline resolution. The supplied runner invokes the root-level executable against the staged specification examples.

### Story Realization Map

| BLOCKS-001 | Paragraphs; thematic breaks | `sources/spec.txt` — Paragraphs; Thematic breaks | `sources/spec_tests.py` | capability, scoped checks |

### Test and Acceptance Strategy

Each parser implementation story uses the supplied `spec_tests.py` runner with explicit selectors for the sections it owns. Select example-owning headings such as `ATX headings` and `List items`; do not select chapter headings that own no examples. Scoped checks never invoke `sources/full_test.sh`.

`VERIFY-001` is the sole terminal verification story and depends on every parser implementation story. It runs `sh sources/full_test.sh`, prints captured stdout and stderr, and asserts only `result.returncode == 0`. Its acceptance check declares `Suite: full` and carries `Sea Trials: st-001`.

### Sequencing and Dependencies

Implement the executable interface first, then block structure in the specification’s block-first order, followed by inline parsing. Inline links depend on the reference definitions collected during block parsing. The final verification story follows all implementation stories. Stage the runner’s imports and input files together: `spec_tests.py`, `cmark.py`, `normalize.py`, and `spec.txt`, as well as the supplied shell harness.

### Source Conflicts and Gaps

No conflicting product definitions or unresolved human-owned decisions were found. The unattended UAT policy resolves the identity proposal without emitting a questionnaire.

# COMPASS: CommonMark

## Compass
CommonMark is a command-line parser for converting Markdown documents into HTML. It serves callers that provide Markdown on standard input and consume rendered HTML on standard output. Build it to conform to the supplied CommonMark 0.31.2 specification and conformance examples.

## Constraints
- Deliver an executable named `commonmark` at the application root.
- Read UTF-8 Markdown from standard input and write HTML to standard output.
- Resolve block structure before inline structure, including document-wide link reference definitions.
- Keep the supplied scoring assets unchanged; they are restored and hash-verified before grading.
- The complete scoring command is `sh sources/full_test.sh`.

## Guardrails
- Do not use a public Markdown implementation.
- Do not modify or replace the supplied scoring entry point or its assets.
- Do not invoke the full scoring harness from scoped parser checks.
